description: The chart illustrates the accuracy of various large language models across different tasks, specifically generation and classification. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, labeled as Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD, while the depth axis represents the task categories, labeled as Generation and Classification. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each model-task combination is represented by a 3D bar with a gradient color scheme transitioning from blue at the bottom to yellow at the top, with the height corresponding to the accuracy value. The bars for Davinci-003 have approximate accuracy values of 0.45 for Generation and 0.5 for Classification, ChatGPT has values of 0.3 and 0.25, and BARD has values of 0.7 and 0.65, respectively. The bars are grouped by model, with each model having two bars representing the two tasks, and are not sorted in a specific order. No bars are visually emphasized.
